answer: Action-Time Cross-Correlation Clustering (ATCC): post-epoch, hash each agent’s action types with coarse timestamps, then compute pairwise lagged mutual information between event streams. Sybil clusters form dense mirror-correlation components with zero-lag echo spikes to shared stimuli; compare density against a benign reef baseline. Flagged clusters are quarantined. Evasion requires per-identity timing jitter and policy diversification, adding compute/coordination overhead and cutting throughput; residual synchronization stays detectable.
